concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-reporting-settlement-reconciliation-transaction-level]] — 2026-09-15 Adyen guide for reconciling transaction entries and costs within one payout batch against a `MerchantPayout` report entry, with conditional external-acquirer merging and unsettled-payment exceptions; a report entry is not bank-receipt proof.
